sections.name: InputProps
sections.title: Single-line text box
sections.what: Draws a single-line text box with an optional label and an optional error message. An error turns the border red and shows the message below. Other settings pass straight through to the box.
sections.why: Likely reason: one shared box keeps forms uniform, and passing settings through keeps every normal input option available.
sections.watch_out: The label is not connected to the box, so clicking it does not focus the field, and screen readers may not link the two.

sections.name: TextareaProps
sections.title: Multi-line text area
sections.what: Draws a multi-line text area with the same label, error and pass-through behavior as the text box. Its resize handle is turned off.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code for turning off resizing; a fixed size keeps forms tidy.
sections.watch_out: With resizing off, long text has to be read by scrolling inside a small box.

summary: Shared text box and multi-line text area, with an optional label and an error message.
purpose: Give every form the same look and error display.
why: Likely reason: shared fields keep forms consistent, and the forwarded reference lets forms read the value directly.
how: 1. Takes the label, error text and any normal input settings. 2. Shows the label above the box if one is given. 3. Draws the box with a red border when an error is present. 4. Shows the error text below the box. The text area works the same way with a fixed resize setting.
inputs: A label, an error message, a type, the current value and change handler, and any normal input settings.
outputs: A styled field on screen. Typed text goes back to the form through its change handler.
risks: The label is not connected to its box, so clicking the label does not focus the box. Error styling only appears when an error message is passed.
debug: If the field looks plain, check that the error text or class names are passed correctly. If typing does not change the form, check the change handler the parent provides.
